events.title: NW Trail Sisters Dig Day @ Rocky Point
events.location: Rocky Point Mountain Bike Trail Network, 23999 Rocky Point Road, Scappoose, OR 97056, US
events.note: Organized by: Northwest Trail Alliance — https://www.eventbrite.com/o/17416465786 Join the Trail Sisters for a day of trail work at Rocky Point. Join the Trail Sisters as we get after some trail work, including corridor refining, bench work and armoring. No experience is required. Trail Sisters are women and nonbinary folks who support each other on and off the trail. The dig will run from 9:30 am to 1 or 2 pm. Please arrive 10-15 minutes early to ensure that you are ready to roll. We are starting promptly at 9:30 am. We will meet in the main parking lot at Rocky Point. What to bring: Warm clothing and extra layers. Rain jacket (and rain pants if you have them and the weather calls for it): It’s January in the PNW, odds are high it’ll rain, but that doesn’t stop us from digging! Gloves (waterproof are best): It wouldn’t hurt to bring an extra pair, too. Cold hands suck!

events.title: Grace and Gratitude a Sound and Stillness Immersion
events.location: 1805 St Helens Street, Saint Helens, OR, United States, Oregon 97051
events.note: Use the discount code "Gratitude" at check out for 10% off. Please bring a non perishable food item for the food bank. The holiday season begins this weekend and it’s easy to get swept up in the whirlwind of activities. What if you paused to focus on you? Gratitude and self-care offer essential practices to help you stay grounded, energized, and aligned, especially during the winter holiday seasons. You’re invited to carve out sacred time for yourself to find balance, deep relaxation and inner calm. Uplift your mind, body, and spirit to gracefully carry yourself through the demands of the time. The immersion begins with April’s guidance in meditation and gentle breath work, to bring us fully into the present moment.
